name: Hiding Place for Tablets for dogs

variants.name: 100 g
variants.about_this_item:
• makes giving medication easier
  • press tablet into the opening and close it

Hiding place for tablets for dogs Your dog needs medication and refuses to swallow it? Our hiding place for tablets can help you ensure that your four-legged friend takes the tablets without any problems and in the correct dosage. Developed with veterinarians, the dog treat has a small opening into which the tablet can be pushed effortlessly. Since the snack is soft, the opening closes easily and the tablet is no longer visible. Your dog gets his tasty treat swallowing the tablet without any problems at the same time.
